disciplines.name: Triage
disciplines.description: Prioritise wounded people by immediate treatment need.

disciplines.name: Bleeding control
disciplines.description: Stop dangerous blood loss with available supplies.

disciplines.name: Arrow extraction
disciplines.description: Remove embedded arrows with controlled technique.

disciplines.name: Fracture splints
disciplines.description: Support broken limbs during urgent evacuation.

disciplines.name: Burn care
disciplines.description: Cool and protect tissue injured by heat.

disciplines.name: Camp surgery
disciplines.description: Perform urgent procedures in a temporary infirmary.

disciplines.name: Field sanitation
disciplines.description: Keep crowded treatment grounds separated from waste.

disciplines.name: Stretcher teams
disciplines.description: Organise carriers moving injured people to care.

disciplines.name: Medicine stores
disciplines.description: Maintain treatment supplies against sudden demand.

disciplines.name: Trauma nursing
disciplines.description: Nurse severe injuries through the first recovery period.

disciplines.name: Battle shock
disciplines.description: Support people distressed after terrifying conflict.

disciplines.name: Infection watching
disciplines.description: Watch injuries for signs of spreading infection.

disciplines.name: Evacuation routes
disciplines.description: Plan safe paths away from active fighting.

disciplines.name: Casualty records
disciplines.description: Record injuries, treatment and patient locations.

disciplines.name: Medic instruction
disciplines.description: Prepare others for disciplined emergency medical duties.
